It also provides brickwork; concrete; cement; electrical and bathroom and kitchen products; doors putty and windows; roofing and ceiling products; tools and hardware; inverters petrol generators lighting and gas solutions; soft drinks and snacks; and outdoor and decorative products. It serves contractors homebuilders and improvers farmers traders and other customers. The company operates through the Cashbuild model and P&L Hardware stores. Cashbuild Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A.
Description: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. engages in the sale of cars and spare parts in Tunisia. It also manufactures electronic equipment comprising filters for the automotive and real estate development industries. The company was formerly known as Renault Tunisie. Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Syn Prop & Tech S.A.
Description: We are SYN and we have a deep understanding of the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Our business is to make our clients' lives easier so they can focus on their own businesses. We serve various market segments including shopping malls commercial buildings and warehouses. Our services encompass leasing management as well as buying and selling commercial properties. Our team consists of experts in management projects engineering security technology and business with experience autonomy and a lot of talent for innovation to deliver the best solutions. Every day we wake up and dedicate ourselves to ensuring that companies and retailers feel at ease achieve their goals and thrive. We work behind the scenes taking care of people's experiences in SYN spaces while they work shop and have fun.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through the Car Rental and Leasing segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short-term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name; replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies; and other complementary products including the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. Its Leasing Business segment offers leasing services of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities; complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services; and service and maintenance plans. In addition the company sells its cars from its rental and leasing businesses to retail customers and wholesalers through dealerships wholesale outlets online channels and independent wholesalers. It also engages in the advertisement of its retail vehicles through Avis Car Sales and other third-party websites as well as the sale of wholesale stock through the Avis Auction online auction trading platform and bulk deal offerings directly to the market. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. acquires develops and operates beach and urban hotels in Mexico. It operates in three segments: Urban Services Resort Services and Operator and Holding. The company operates a portfolio of 27 hotels under the Krystal Grand Krystal Hotels & Resorts Krystal Beach and Krystal Urban brands as well as under licensed brands such as Hilton Hilton Resorts Hilton Garden Inn and Hampton Inn & Suites. It also operates third-party hotels. Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. operates as a real estate investment and management company in Brazil. The company is involved in management of own or third-party real estate developments including shopping malls centers; purchase and sale of ready-made or under-construction residential and commercial properties; leasing of real estate; and operation of rotating parking. Its portfolio includes office buildings and convenience centers. São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Allied Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Allied Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes technology products in Brazil and Latin America. It engages in the wholesale and retail trade of telephone computer electronic devices accessories and peripherals. The company also provides logistics services; delivery and storage services; program development and licensing; image processing and services related to enabling data voice and recharge plans; and payment services deposit transfer and/or withdrawal of funds management of payment accounts issuance of payment instruments and others. It sells its products through digital retail including marketplaces e-commerce platforms and digital operations solutions; physical retail such as brand shops; and distribution channels. The company was formerly known as Dstar Participações S.A. and changed its name to Allied Tecnologia S.A. in November 2015. Allied Tecnologia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. develops operates and manages hotels in Mexico Costa Rica Colombia and Chile. The company operates hotels under the City Junior by Marriott City Express Suites by Marriott City Express by Marriott City Express Plus by Marriott and City Centro by Marriott brands. It also provides marketing technical and administrative; real estate development; restaurant operation and catering; and IT server maintenance update and equipment rental services as well as software platforms and applications; and dashboards for hotel managers and operating teams. In addition the company develops Front2Go a property management system; hires personnel or third parties for the development of civil works; and invests in hospitality industry projects. It serves business travelers. The company was formerly known as Hoteles City Express S.A.B. de C.V. and changed its name to Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. in April 2024. Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells semi-finished cleaning papers in Turkey. It offers jumbo rolls napkins toilet papers and kitchen towels under the Softy Mare Ritmo Ecco Y.D Dolce and Unico brands as well as private label brands. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of restaurants under the BigChefs NumNum and Buselik brands in Turkey and internationally. It also franchises its restaurants. Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Libstar Holdings Limited
Description: Libstar Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and markets branded and private label consumer packaged goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through three segments: Perishable Products Ambient Products and Household and Personal Care Products. The company offers refrigerated or frozen products including dairy convenience meals value-added meats and fresh mushrooms; wet and dry condiments meal ingredients baking and snacking and spreads; and household cleaning products as well as personal care products. It also provides baby food products; and beverages. The company sells its products under the Lancewood Millennium Foods Finlar Fine Foods Denny Mushrooms Umatie Rialto Cape Herb & Spice Khoisan Gourmet Cape Foods Montagu Foods Cecil Vinegar Dickon Hall Foods Cape Coastal Honey Chamonix Amaro Foods Cani Ambassador Foods Contactim and retailer brands to retail and wholesale food service industrial contract manufacturing and export channels. Libstar Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Plattekloof South Africa.

Name: Vittia S.A.
Description: Vittia S.A. provides fertilizers in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Foliar Fertilizers and Industrial Products; Soil Micronutrients; Soil Conditioners and Organominerals; and Biological Products. It offers biological organomineral foliar bio and concentrated suspension fertilizers; adjuvants; biological pesticides comprising microbiological and macrobiological control; inoculants; sulfur; acaricides; soil conditioners; vegetable nutrition products consist of chloride CoMo phosphite macro nitrate soluble powders and concentrated suspensions; sulphates; and granulated micronutrients and salts for agriculture and livestock. The company was formerly known as Vittia Fertilizantes e Biológicos S.A. and changed its name to Vittia S.A. in May 2023. Vittia S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in São Joaquim da Barra Brazil.

Name: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc
Description: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and sells various consumer products and home appliances to wholesalers in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Home and Personal Care Products; and Durable Electrical Appliances. The company offers detergents soaps cosmetics refrigerators freezers air-conditioners televisions generators and washing machines. The company also sells its products under the Morning Fresh Zip Canoe Premier Excel Joy Stella Venus Imperial Leather Cussons Baby Original Source Carex Robb and Haier Thermocool brands. The company was formerly known as Paterson Zochonis Industries Plc and changed its name to PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc in September 2006. The company was founded in 1899 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of PZ Cussons (Holdings) Limited.

Name: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and marketing of manganese minerals and ferroalloys in Mexico and internationally. It is also involved in the electricity generation and mining of precious metals. The company offers ferroalloy and manganese products including high medium and low carbon ferromanganese; silicomanganese; nitrided medium carbon ferromanganese; manganese nodules and carbonates; and other specialty ferroalloys as well as manganese derivatives such as battery-grade natural manganese dioxide ceramic-grade natural manganese dioxide and manganous oxide products. In addition the company generates electricity through hydroelectric plant; and produces electrolytic manganese dioxides. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Autlán Holding SAPI de CV.

Name: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes IT products in Turkey. The company’s products portfolio includes computers/tablets smartphones printers consumer electronics software peripherals wearable technologies data storage products smart home products and accessories. It purchases and sells spare parts and home electronics as well as provides logistics and rental services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi
Description: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi provides electricity contracting services in Turkey. It offers electrical contracting services for weak current systems LV electrical contract works and MV electrical contract works as well as construction services. The company was formerly known as ORGE Enerji Sistemleri Insaat Metal Ticaret ve Taahhüt A.S. and changed its name to Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi in June 2010. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells bed furniture quilt armchair sofa home textile and home furniture. The company offers beds and mattresses; home textile products that include duvet covers and sets bedspreads blankets sheets and pillow cases bathroom textiles cushions and covers sofa throws and dowry sets; base and headboard sets; and home and sitting room products such as TV blanket slipper pet bed and room fragrances. It sells its products through stores. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kayseri Turkey.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company offers private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical audit services processing of medical bills call center operations claims and hospital network management system licensing and other outsourced healthcare support services. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. Name: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.
Description: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. The company operates through three segments: Chemical Products Paper and Other Operations. It offers paper pulp coated paper and photocopy paper; ivory glass paper wet strength label paper soap paper and special paper for religious books; and label papers soap packaging papers envelope papers and blueprint papers white kraft papers and cup papers. The company also provides sodium sulphate potassium sulphate salt and magnesium chloride liquid. In addition it offers Insurance intermediary services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme
Description: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme provides leasing and factoring services in Tunisia Algeria Ivory Coast Senegal Burkina Faso Mali Cameroon Gabon Kenya Zambia and Tanzania. It provides financing solutions including auto transport building equipment medical and real estate. It also provides long term rental services. It serves liberal professions craftsmen traders and farmers. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tunis Tunisia. Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme is a subsidiary of Amen Bank Société anonyme.

Name: Positivo Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Positivo Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures sells and distributes hardware software and information technology (IT) solutions in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Consumer Public Institutions and Corporate segments. The company offers computers smartphones tablets accessories smart home and environment devices office products electronic security devices servers mobile payment terminals payment machines and IT infrastructure products; education technology solutions including self-service kiosks data collection devices for demographic surveys and electronic voting machines; and medical laboratory and communication equipment. It also engages in the rental of IT and mobility (hardware as a service) equipment; provision of IT technical support and managed IT services; sale of pedagogic application systems and school administration products; technical-pedagogical planning and support; and representation sale implementation training support and technical assistance for equipment as well as for technical technological and scientific teaching systems. The company was formerly known as Positivo Informática S.A. and changed its name to Positivo Tecnologia S.A. in April 2017. Positivo Tecnologia S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Curitiba Brazil.

Name: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail sale of technology products in Turkey. It sells its products through its stores; air conditioners and refrigerators through its dealer network; and solar energy systems. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Unilever Ghana PLC
Description: Unilever Ghana PLC manufactures and markets sells fast-moving consumer goods in Ghana. It operates through the Nutrition Home Care and Beauty & Personal Care segments. The company provides laundry and household care products; and skin cleansing skin care oral and deodorant products. It is also involved in investment management; real estate development; and manufacturing importing and exporting goods wares and merchandise. The company is headquartered in Tema Ghana. Unilever Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

Name: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides consumer electronics products in Turkey. The company offers cables adapters bags covers and similar accessory products for audio and video products. It also provides maintenance and repair services. Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes its products under the Apple Beats by Dr.Dre JBL Harman Kardon Thule Case Logic Marshall Urbanears and Hama Brands. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: GOIL Plc
Description: GOIL Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the marketing of petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. It offers jet fuels fuels liquefied petroleum gas auto LP gas lubricants bitumen polymer aviation fuel and specialty products; bunkering services; marine gas oil; distributes various petroleum products including gasoline kerosene diesel marine and mining diesel and lubricants and premix fuel; and provides fuel cards. In addition the company offers electronic payments money transfers and other IT-related business; consultancy; and other support services. It operates through retail network of service stations and consumer outlets as well as lube bays. The company was formerly known as Ghana Oil Company. GOIL Plc was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Automob Participações S.A.
Description: Automob Participações S.A. engages in retailing trucks buses machinery and equipment in Brazil. The company is based in Cuiabá Brazil. Automob Participações S.A. is a subsidiary of Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A.

Name: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S.
Description: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. produces and sells tires under the Goodyear Fulda Sava Debica and Kelly brands worldwide. It offers tires for consumers; and aviation commercial truck off-the-road racing and recreational vehicle tires. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. is a subsidiary of Goodyear S.A.

Name: Cadbury Nigeria Plc
Description: Cadbury Nigeria Plc engages in manufacturing and selling branded fast moving consumer goods in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Refreshment Beverages Confectionery and Intermediate Cocoa Products. The Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and sells Cadbury Bournvita and Cadbury 3-in-1 Hot Chocolate. The Confectionary segment manufactures and sells Tom Tom Candy Caramel Buttermint Candy Coffee and Clorets gum products. The Intermediate Cocoa Products segment manufactures and sells cocoa powder cocoa butter cocoa liquor and cocoa cake. It offers its products through a network of distributors key accounts and institutional customers as well as chain of wholesalers and retailers. It exports its products to various countries in Africa and Europe. Cadbury Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Cadbury Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Cadbury Schweppes Overseas Limited.

Name: CM Hospitalar S/A
Description: CM Hospitalar S/A engages in the distribution of hospital materials medicines and nutrition products in Brazil. Name: NEM Insurance Plc
Description: NEM Insurance Plc provides general insurance products and services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria and Europe. The company offers corporate insurance products such as motor marine cargo and hull aviation oil and gas engineering computer and electronics fidelity guarantee and group personal accident insurance; personal insurance products including goods in transit fire and special perils travel motor home protection professional indemnity and enhanced motor third party insurance; and SME products comprising burglary product liability fidelity guarantee motor insurance cash in transit group personal accident and agricultural insurance products. It involved in asset leasing and LPO financing activities. It offers its products to manufacturing industrial commercial enterprises and financial institutions such as banks mortgage and stock broking firms. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Aluminium Du Maroc SA
Description: Aluminium Du Maroc SA together with its subsidiaries designs and manufactures aluminium alloy profiles in Morocco Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal. The company offers extrusion anodization powder coating thermal cutting and completion. It also provides industrial solutions including CAD design of customized profiles on Autocad software calculation of mechanical properties of the profile feasibility and cost analysis development of dies supply of samples prototypes manufacturing production of pre-series and large-scale production; and architectural solutions such as windows sliding windows skylights sunshades blinds curtain walls gates railings pergolas interior partitions. It exports its products to Europe and Africa. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tangier Morocco.

Name: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A.
Description: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. engages in the general retail trade activities in Brazil. It offers construction tools home appliances cell phones decoration organization furniture garden TVs and audio small appliances bed table and bath cleaning household utilities children's fashion and lifestyle air conditioning computing sports beauty automotive musical instruments technology office and stationery agribusiness and health products. The company also provides credit card and financial services. Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Cachoeirinha Brazil.

Name: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A.
Description: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A. engages in the developments leasing and management of real estate assets in Brazil. It operates convenience centers corporate buildings shopping centers hotels and parking lots as well as provides self-storage units +Box built to suit rent agreements and sale lease back services. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes Brazil.

Name: Conoil Plc
Description: Conoil Plc markets refined petroleum products and manufactures and markets lubricants household and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: White Products Lubricants and Liquefied Petroleum Gas. The White Products segment sells premium motor spirit aviation turbine kerosene dual-purpose kerosene low-pour fuel oil and automotive gasoline/grease oil. Its Lubricants segment offers transport and industrial lubricants greases process oil and bitumen. The LPG segment is involved in the trading of bulk and packed LPG cylinders and valves. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc and changed its name to Conoil Plc in January 2003. Conoil Plc was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Conoil Plc is a subsidiary of Conpetro Limited.

Name: Veste S.A. Estilo
Description: Veste S.A. Estilo manufacture and sells clothing and clothing accessories in Brazil. The company offers dress for women under the Le Lis brand; business clothing for men and women under the Dudalina brand; denim jeans for men and women under the John John brand; leisure and party outfits under the Bo.Bô brand; and men’s wear under the Individual brand. It sells its products through its own stores multi-brand stores outlets and e-commerce. The company was formerly known as Restoque Comércio e Confecções de Roupas S.A. and changed its name to Veste S.A. Estilo in January 2023. Veste S.A. Estilo was incorporated in 1982 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: AIICO Insurance Plc
Description: AIICO Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting and related financial services in Nigeria. It operates through Life Insurance General Business Health Management and Asset Management segments. The life insurance segment offers whole life term assurance guaranteed pensions endowment pensions mortgage endowment savings and protection products as well as other long-term contracts. The General Business segment provides auto household commercial and business interruption insurance; and general insurance to individuals and businesses. The Health Management segment offers prepaid health plans to cater for the health needs of individuals and corporate organizations. The Asset Management segments offers portfolio management services structured investments and mutual funds for corporate and individual clients. In addition the company offers annuity property marine fire personal accident pure risk home and travel insurance as well as marine manufacturing agricultural and oil and gas insurance; and various risk plans. It markets its products through insurance brokers and agents. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc
Description: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries underwrites risk and non-life insurance contracts in Nigeria. It operates through Non Life Business Life Business Insurance Asset Management Property development and Health Maintenance segments. The company offers life and saving products such as whole life term life cash back term life life celebration instant plan bonus life life saving education plan group life insurance; health insurance including group and employee health plans and third party administrator plan; and investments which includes money market fund equity income fund education trust employee investment scheme and customized portfolio. It also provides business insurance plan agric motor home money travel group personal accident marine fire and special peril burglary insurance fidelity liability goods-in-transit and engineering insurance. The company was formerly known as Mansard Insurance Plc and changed its name to AXA Mansard Insurance Plc in July 2015. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. AXA Mansard Insurance Plc operates as a subsidiary of Assur Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S.
Description: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S. together with its subsidiaries owns and operates hospitals in Turkey. It is also involved in designing platform to compare the content presentation form and prices of the services provided by the contracted health services; and operation of medical units. In addition the company offers insurance and brokerage services; health services; milk and livestock breeding; and laboratory services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the design urbanization construction promotion and sale of homes in Mexico. The company develops social interest middle-class middle-residential and residential housing. Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 2001 and is based in Cancun Mexico.

Name: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A.
Description: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. provides services and products related to environmental management worldwide. The company operates through the Environment Response and Others segments. The company provides crisis management and emergency response services; industrial cleaning and repair and maintenance services; maritime services such as port support and offshore services; water production and supply and effluent management; energy generation services from waste; and waste management and decarbonization services. Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Méliuz S.A.
Description: Méliuz S.A. together with its subsidiaries operate a virtual portal for the placement and dissemination of brands products services and other advertising and publicity materials. It operates through B2C (BusinesstoCustomers)National; and Other segments. The company offers leasing of virtual advertising space for the insertion of texts drawings and other materials as well as rental of space. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Fan Milk PLC
Description: Fan Milk PLC produces manufactures and distributes recombined milk and other dairy products in Ghana Nigeria Côte d'Ivoire Togo and Burkina Faso. It offers frozen dairy juice dairy drinkable and spoonable and ice cream products under the FanVanille FanYogo SuperYogo FanXtra FanChoco FanDango FanJoy FanMaxx yogo FanIce VIKINGStar Goslo and Yaourt brand names. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Fan Milk PLC is a subsidiary of Fan Milk International A/S.

Name: Wifack International Bank Société anonyme
Description: Wifack International Bank Société anonyme engages in Islamic banking operations in Tunisia. The company offers accounts; short medium and long-term financing services; bank cards; and digital banking services. It also offers insurance services that include sharia compliant products. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Medenine Tunisia.

Name: Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells medical devices in Turkey. The company offers breathing sytems products including breathing circuits breathing filters catheter mounts gas sampling lines accessories masks and connectors. It also provides hospital products such as barrier cream surgical hand brushes for skin disinfection hand and skin antiseptics and skin and mucosa antiseptics. In addition the company engages in the manufacturing and sale of anesthesia and intensive care circuits; installation operation and design of oncology drug preparation and delivery systems; production sales and technical service of infusion pumps and sets; and manufacturing of biocidal products. It also exports its products to 80 countries under its Altech brand name. Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops constructs and sells residential and commercial real estate properties for middle-class and upper middle-class customers in Brazil. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Cornerstone Insurance Plc
Description: Cornerstone Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries offers risk underwriting and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life Insurance Life Insurance Takaful Insurance Fin Insurance Leasing and Life Deposit Administration/Investment Contracts. It offers property-casualty and life/health insurance products. The company also provides motor vehicle aviation marine engineering all risks asset protection liability to third party oil and gas group life credit life mortgage protection term assurance wealth creation Takaful fire and burglary gadget protection goods in transit home personal accident and travel insurance products. In addition it offers leasing services; and investment products. Cornerstone Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: MPM Corpóreos S.A.
Description: MPM Corpóreos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides laser hair removal services in Brazil Chile Argentina Colombia and Paraguay. It operates through Laser International Operations and Franchising (Royalties) segments. The company offers physiotherapy services in the areas of laser hair removal and facial and body aesthetics under the Espaçolaser Cela and Definit brands. It also franchises its stores. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Helbor Empreendimentos S.A.
Description: Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. engages in the real estate development business in Brazil. Its portfolio includes residential and commercial properties. The company was formerly known as Helbor Empreendimentos Imobiliarios Ltda. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes Brazil.

Name: Compagnie Internationale de Leasing S.A.
Description: Compagnie Internationale de Leasing S.A. engages in the finance leasing stock market intermediation and private equity businesses in Tunisia. It provides leasing services for real estate properties rolling stocks and equipment for industrial and professional usage as well as for green materials. Compagnie Internationale de Leasing S.A. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
Description: Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter Ethical Products and Consumer Healthcare Product. It offers drugs infusions and injectables. The company also provides products for anti infective and anti malaria central nervous system and cough and cold gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions. Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Société Tunisienne de Réassurance
Description: Société Tunisienne de Réassurance operates as a reinsurance company in Tunisia Maghreb Arab countries Africa Europe Asia and internationally. It underwrites fire miscellaneous accidents and engineering agricultural risks marine and energy civil liability emerging risks and life insurance; Tunis Retakaful; and decennial liability aviation and marine pool insurances. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A.
Description: d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. engages in the retail sale of pharmaceutical and perfumery products in Brazil. It also sells generic drugs and hygiene and beauty products. The company was formerly known as Cancun RJ Participações S/A and changed its name to d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. in March 2016. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A.

Name: Société Nouvelle Maison de la Ville de Tunis
Description: Société Nouvelle Maison de la Ville de Tunis together with its subsidiaries engages in the multi-department retailing of various goods and products in Tunisia. It is also involved in the refrigeration freezing processing and packaging of meat agricultural and fishing products as well as offers real estate promotion services. The company was founded in 1933 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: LPS Brasil - Consultoria de Imóveis S.A.
Description: LPS Brasil - Consultoria de Imóveis S.A. provides real estate brokerage services in Brazil. It operates through Brokerage Franchises and Financing Promotion segments. The company provides brokerage services for the sale and purchase of third-party and land subdivision properties; and consulting technical real estate advisory franchises correspondent bank and other related services. It also engages in promoting and offering financial products and services in the real estate market. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Bizim Toptan Satis Magazalari A.S.
Description: Bizim Toptan Satis Magazalari A.S. engages in the wholesale and retail of fast-moving consumer goods in Turkey. The company sells food products including dry food milk and diary snack and bakery delicatessen and breakfast meat and meat products and fruit and vegetable; drink and non-alcoholic beverages; cigarette and tobacco; cleaning items; personal care and cosmetics; paper; household appliances; energy and lighting stationery-office supplies; communication items; pet products; and private label products through various brands. It also operates 182 stores and an online platform. The company sells its products to wholesalers merchants grocery stores markets supermarkets specialized retailers hotels restaurants and cafes as well as gas station markets school canteens SEC Market business partners kiosks catering businesses corporate and individual customers and commercial taxpayers. Bizim Toptan Satis Magazalari A.S. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. The company operates as a subsidiary of Yildiz Holding A.S.

Name: Almarys Limited
Description: Almarys Limited operates agricultural land. The company operates through Agribusiness Real Estate Hospitality & Travel Logistics Finance Commerce & Manufacturing Technology & Energy Investments & Managements Office segments. It also serves sugar cane food crops livestock agri; homes workplaces malls territories; hotels leisure aviation and travel; cross-border logistics landside logistics packing and shipping; credit fiduciary leasing; automotive trade and manufacturing; and technology energy innovation sectors. The company was formerly known as ENL Limited and changed its name to Almarys Limited in September 2025. Almarys Limited was founded in 1821 and is based in Moka Mauritius. Almarys Limited operates as a subsidiary of La Sablonnière Holding Limited.

Name: Societe Magasin General S.A.
Description: Societe Magasin General S.A. engages in the retail wholesale and real estate businesses in Tunisia. The company was formerly known as Ste Magasin General SA. Societe Magasin General S.A. is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Coronation Insurance Plc
Description: Coronation Insurance Plc through its subsidiaries engages in underwriting of life and non-life insurance for individuals and corporate entities. The company operates in two segments General Business and Life Business. It offers current escrow joint and domiciliary accounts; home personal accident car travel life liability marine business vehicle buildings and contents construction business interruption group welfare and life and bancassurance insurance products; asset management such as fixed income private equity equities trust services mutual funds alternatives and advisory services; and estate planning trustee registrar and data management services. The company also provides treasury management products such as liquidity management treasury bills local and foreign currency term deposits commercial papers and notes trading and global currency; yacht and aviation financing and emergency loans; investment banking products including corporate restructuring project finance mergers and acquisitions and capital raising; and wealth management products such as financial planning retirement planning and managed portfolio. In addition it offers securities trading and brokerage services such as investment advisory repo brokerage accounts equities and margin loans; and venture building and capital under technology services. It was formerly known as Wapic Insurance Plc and changed its name to Coronation Insurance Plc in September 2020. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: CalBank PLC
Description: CalBank PLC provides various banking products and services in Ghana. It operates through Corporate Banking; Retail & Business Banking; Treasury; and Asset Management segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers loans and other credit facilities as well as deposits and other transactions and balances to corporate clients institutional clients and public sector entities. This segment also provides corporate finance mergers and acquisitions advice specialized financial advice and custody services. The Retail & Business Banking segment provides loans and overdrafts as well as handles the deposits and other transactions such as funds transfers standing orders and ATM card services for small and medium enterprises and individual customers. The Treasury segment invests in liquid assets including short-term placements and government debt securities as well as trades in foreign currencies. The Asset Management segment offers asset management investment portfolio management cash management money management and other investment advisory services to institutional investors businesses and high net worth individuals; and manages mutual funds. The company holds and administers securities and other assets as a custodian; and manages pension funds on behalf of beneficial owners. CalBank PLC was founded in 1990 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Euro-Cycles S.A
Description: Euro-Cycles S.A manufactures assembles and sells two-wheeled cycles in Tunisia and internationally. The company offers kids mountain road BMX/trick commuting folding and electric bikes as well as beach cruisers. It also provides frames and works welding hubs with phosphating complete line rims production saddles production and assembling powder painting and wheels semi-automatic assembly. In addition the company offers brand identity creative concept support design delivery and safe box. It exports its products to European countries including the United Kingdom Germany Italy the Netherlands Denmark Greece France and Spain. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Sousse Tunisia.

Name: Neogrid Participações S.A.
Description: Neogrid Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops licenses sells and implements customized software for supply chain management and synchronization worldwide. The company also provides related technical advisory and training services. In addition it offers software and databases installation configuration and maintenance services as well as technical IT support services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Joinville Brazil.

Name: Hulamin Limited
Description: Hulamin Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of rolled and extruded aluminum products in South Africa North America Europe Asia the Middle East Australasia South America and rest of Africa. The company operates through two segments Hulamin Rolled Products and Hulamin Extrusions. The Hulamin Rolled Products segment offers aluminum sheets plates and foil products. This segment also manufactures and supplies fabricated and rolled semi-finished aluminum products as well as aluminum foil containers and related products. The Hulamin Extrusions segment manufactures and supplies extruded aluminum products. It serves automotive building electrical general engineering packaging renewable energy and transport industries. The company was formerly known as Hulett Aluminium (Pty) Limited and changed its name to Hulamin Limited in 2007. Hulamin Limited was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Pietermaritzburg South Africa.

Name: Enjoei S.A.
Description: Enjoei S.A. operates a marketplace platform for the purchase and sale of used products in Brazil. The company provides products for girls boys and children including accessories clothes beauty products footwear toys hygiene and well-being and scholarship products. It also offers home and décor electronics home appliances pet products books and stationery music and tv antiques other products etc. The company was formerly known as Enjoei.com.br Atividades de Internet S.A. and changed its name to Enjoei S.A. in May 2021. Enjoei S.A. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Chemical and Allied Products Plc
Description: Chemical and Allied Products Plc manufactures and sells paints and coatings in Nigeria. The company offers decorative and industrial coatings; indoor outdoor specialty and protective coatings; primers; and other products. It sells its products under the Dulux Regular Dulux Trade Caplux Sandtex and Hempel brands. The company distributes its products through Dulux colour stores Dulux colour shops and Sandtex stores. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Chemical and Allied Products Plc is a subsidiary of UAC of Nigeria PLC.

Name: Aeris Indústria e Comércio de Equipamentos para Geração de Energia S.A.
Description: Aeris Indústria e Comércio de Equipamentos para Geração de Energia S.A. manufactures wind blades in Brazil. It also repairs paintings cleaning preventive and corrective maintenance engineering and inspections of all blade models and other wind components photographic inspection services for wind turbines fiber components and towers. In addition it provides blade life extension. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Caucaia Brazil.

Name: G2D Investments Ltd.
Description: G2D Investments Ltd. an investment company invests in technology companies in Brazil Europe and the United States. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Hamilton Bermuda. G2D Investments Ltd. is a subsidiary of GP Investments Ltd.

Name: La Société de Transport des Hydrocarbures par Pipelines SOTRAPIL SA
Description: La Société de Transport des Hydrocarbures par Pipelines SOTRAPIL SA engages in the transportation of hydrocarbons and refined products through pipelines. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: L'Accumulateur Tunisien Assad SA
Description: L'Accumulateur Tunisien Assad SA designs manufactures distributes and recycles lead-acid starting batteries in Tunisia. The company offers Super Turbo VL Turbo VL Turbo Pro Turbo Truck and marine batteries. It is also involved in production and marketing of starter batteries; manufacturing of industrial batteries; wholesale of batteries; and international trade activities. The company’s products are used in automotive marine solar energy leisure industry IT and telecommunications sectors. L'Accumulateur Tunisien Assad SA was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Ben Arous Tunisia.

Name: Telnet Holding SA
Description: Telnet Holding SA a product engineering company that provides technological solutions to various business domains in Tunisia. It specializes in research and development software engineering products network integration and telecom and product life cycle management services and mechanical studies. The company offers embedded software electronic design mechanical concept internet of things digital application cloud computing and artificial intelligence solutions. It serves the aerospace telecom and media energy and electronic payment sectors. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Eterna Plc
Description: Eterna Plc an integrated energy company manufactures and sells lubricating oils and petrochemicals in Nigeria. The company operates through Retail and Industrial and Lubricants and Chemicals segments. The Retail and Industrial segment is involved in the sale and distribution of petroleum products including white products in retail outlets small units and to industrial customers. The Lubricants and Chemicals segment distributes manufactured and imported lubricants and chemicals to marine and energy customers. The company also imports and sells bulk petroleum products such as premium motor spirit automotive gas oil low pour fuel oil base oils and bitumen. In addition it provides bunkering; gas distribution; liquefied petroleum gas and natural gas marketing; offshore and onshore oil; and gas processing services as well as trade in crude oil and other refined petroleum products. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Eterna Plc operates as a subsidiary of Preline Limited.

Name: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited
Description: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited develops and manages integrated residential properties in South Africa. It operates in two segments Residential Property Development and Memorial Parks. The Residential Property Development segment engages in mid to high income housing and integrated housing developments. The Memorial Parks segment develops and manages memorial parks as well as provides burial rights and associated burial and maintenance services. It also invests in real estate properties. Calgro M3 Holdings Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa.

Name: Grupo Toky S.A.
Description: Grupo Toky S.A. operates in the electronic commerce business. It retails various articles in the furniture decorative items sofa wardrobe mattresses office chairs dinning sets housewares children garden and leisure remodeling and garage electro and other sectors which focuses on direct sales to consumers and indirect sales through partnering companies. The company engages in the activities related to the logistics of furniture to third parties. In addition it sells its products through www.mobly.com.br website. Grupo Toky S.A. was formerly known as Mobly S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Toky S.A. in May 2025. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Grupo Toky S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Home24 Holding Gmbh & Co. Kg.

Name: May & Baker Nigeria plc
Description: May & Baker Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures sells and distributes human pharmaceuticals human vaccines and consumer products in Nigeria. It operates through Pharmaceuticals and Beverage segments. The company offers pharmaceuticals including anti-diabetic anti-hypersensitive anti-infective anti-malaria analgesic cough and cold and anxiolytics; and nature care products. It also provides beverage drinks including bottled water under the Lily Water name; and hand and surface sanitizers under the Smartans name. In addition the company engages in contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical products; and in healthcare and industrial packaging. May & Baker Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: LASACO Assurance Plc
Description: LASACO Assurance Plc provides various insurance products and services in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life and Life segments. It also offers anticipated plan mortgage protection bond education fire special peril and householders insurance. In addition the company provides contractors all risk burglary public liability plants all risk insurance; business interruption money insurance fidelity guarantee goods in transit employers liability computer all risk and motor insurance. Further it offers marine hull machinery breakdown builders’ liability oil and gas erection all risk group life professional indemity insurance. LASACO Assurance Plc serves heavy engineering and construction banking and finance manufacturing agriculture tourism oil and gas and aerospace sectors; and term assurance investment plan occupiers’ liability personal accident investment linked and lasaco marine cargo insurance. The company distributes its products through various forms of brokers agencies and direct marketing programs. LASACO Assurance Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc
Description: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc manufactures and markets pharmaceutical and animal health products in Nigeria and Ghana. It provides health care ethical and veterinary related products; and poultry and animal range of anthelmintic products as well as production enhancing medicaments. The company was formerly known as Pfizer Inc. and changed its name to Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc. In 1997. Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Tecnisa S.A.
Description: Tecnisa S.A. develops and constructs residential and commercial real estate properties in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Tecnisa Engenharia. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Société Industrielle d'Appareillage et de Matériels Electriques
Description: Société Industrielle d'Appareillage et de Matériels Electriques engages in the manufacture and marketing of electrical and electromechanical equipment in Tunisia Africa and the Middle East. The company offers electric gas and water meters. It also provides protection and control equipment such as circuit breakers switches industrial contactors and gas detectors; and low and medium voltage line accessories. In addition the company offers electrical connection accessories including mini and domestic boxes fix clips R Parter Floor and junction blocks; modular switches and accessories; and LBC low energy lamps as well offer plastic injections; and provides assembly of electromechanical parts mainly for the automotive sector. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Grombalia Tunisia.

Name: C & I Leasing Plc
Description: C & I Leasing Plc provides marine services in Nigeria Ghana and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Marine Fleet Management/ Hetrz Rent-A- Car Outsourcing and Citracks segments. The company offers onshore and offshore terminal services including berthing and escort mooring line and hose handling pollution control and floating and self-elevating platforms. It manages vehicles and professional chauffeurs that provides pick-up and drop-off reservation airport shuttle and daily rental services under the Hertz-Rent-A car brand. In addition the company provides manpower recruitment and development training business process outsourcing e-business personnel outsourcing and human resource consultancy services. Further it offers fleet management and telematics solutions. Additionally the company is involved in equipment leasing; trading in ships and boats; and provision of chartered vessels. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. C & I Leasing Plc is a subsidiary of Pmt Global Investments Nigeria Limited.

Name: BH Leasing Société Anonyme
Description: BH Leasing Société Anonyme engages in the leasing business in Tunisia. The company engages in the real estate leasing business including financing the acquisition or construction of commercial premises administrative premises storage store and warehouse clinics and radio centers. It provides automobile leasing services. In addition the company offers furniture leasing services for construction machinery operating equipment medical equipment and computer equipment. The company was formerly known as Modern Leasing SA. BH Leasing Société Anonyme was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. BH Leasing Société Anonyme is a subsidiary of BH Bank Société anonyme.

Name: Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A.
Description: Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A. provides telecommunications services in Tunisia and internationally. Its services' portfolio comprises architecture design and engineering audit advice/consulting project management training implementation and integration and support and maintenance. The company is also involved in deployment of networks and fiber optic backbone PDH-SDH and WDM; copper networks and related environmental solutions; implementation of FTTx high speed broadband telecommunications framework; and energy air conditioning and security systems installation testing and measurement activities. In addition it offers communications and information solutions; develops security policy framework; intrusion prevention and advanced detection functions; cloud computing security solutions; and consulting services for analysis implementation and management of content; unified communications and collaboration work tools comprising fixed-line and mobile telephony over IP videotelephony audio/video conferencing contact centers and IVRs and office automation tools as well as unified and instant messaging calendars word processing presentation software presence and telepresence web conferencing and document sharing and management systems; multimedia contact screens; surveillance systems; and various television and interactive services. Further the company assists in renovating lighting installations; and provides smart waste management waste-collection management smart irrigation and smart metering solutions as well as managed security services network management platforms and systems and performance management solutions. Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Berger Paints Nigeria Plc
Description: Berger Paints Nigeria Plc manufactures distributes and sells paints and allied products in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Paints and Allied Products Contract Revenue and Investment Property Rental Income. The company also leases real estate properties; and offers painting services. Berger Paints Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Ikeja Nigeria.

Name: Les Ciments de Bizerte
Description: Les Ciments de Bizerte manufactures sells and exports cement clinker lime and all related and derived products in Tunisia. The company offers products including Portland cement and limestone; and artificial hydraulic lime. Les Ciments de Bizerte was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Bizerte Tunisia.

Name: Essoukna
Description: Essoukna engages in the real estate business in Tunisia. It is involved in the development of land for housing units; and construction or renovation for sale or rental of buildings. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Essoukna operates as a subsidiary of Société Immobilière et de Participations.
